mapper.select: /* CastChknMapper.retrieveSmltChknList */ SELECT A.YMD, A.TIME, B.TMNL_ID, C.ALN_CD, A.FCLT_CD, A.ISLAND, A.COUNTER_NUM, A.WTNG_PSG_CNT, A.PRCS_HR, A.WTNG_HR FROM ( SELECT A.SMLT_ID, REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 0, 10), '/', '') YMD, REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 12, 5), ':', '') TIME, PSG_FCLT_CD, SUBSTR(A.PSG_FCLT_CD, 3) FCLT_CD, SUBSTR(A.PSG_FCLT_CD, 3, 1) ISLAND, PMOWN.FN_PM_SAFE_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 2) ) COUNTER_NUM, A.WTNG_PSG_CNT, A.AVG_PRCS_HR as PRCS_HR, A.AVG_WTNG_HR as WTNG_HR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A WHERE A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 ) A INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD = 'CC' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD INNER JOIN ( SELECT C.TMNL_ID, C.ALN_CD, C.CKNCT_ID, C.OPER_YMD, C.EST_BGNG_HM, C.EST_END_HM FROM GOOWN.TI_GO_CKNCT_DALY_ALOT C WHERE C.OPER_YMD = #{ymd} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) C ON 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = C.TMNL_ID AND A.FCLT_CD = C.CKNCT_ID AND A.YMD = C.OPER_YMD AND A.TIME BETWEEN C.EST_BGNG_HM AND C.EST_END_HM WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.ISLAND = #{island} ORDER BY YMD, TIME, COUNTER_NUM

/* CastChknMapper.retrieveCknctCntList */ SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS ISLAND, COUNT(A.CKNCT_ID) AS CKNCT_CNT FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' -- A, B 유인 체크인카운터 / H 셀프백드랍 AND A.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY ISLAND

/* CastChknMapper.retrieveAlnCdList */ SELECT DISTINCT A.ALN_CD FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_ALN_PGE A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} -- C 체크인용 페이지를 가진 항공사 = 그 터미널에서 부스 배정이 가능한 항공사 AND A.PGE_SE_CD = 'C' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ALN_CD
